basic_info.description: Offered for sale is 417 Teresita Blvd, a lovely 3BD/2BA plus family room home in desirable Miraloma Park. The light-filled living room features Mt. Davidson views, a corner fireplace, vaulted ceilings, parquet floors, and recessed lighting. Adjacent is the formal dining room with matching parquet floors, recessed lighting, and access to the center patio. Two spacious rear bedrooms enjoy terrific views, complemented by a remodeled bath with a walk-in shower. The kitchen with adjoining breakfast room completes the main level. Downstairs offers a large bedroom, remodeled bathroom, and direct garage/storage access. The lower level includes a large family/playroom that opens to the landscaped yard.  Garage and an abundance of storage throughout the home. 417 Teresita Blvd. is ideally located near Mollie Stone's, West Portal, Noe Valley, Glen Park, public transportation, and quick freeway access to 101 and 280.
